sources.title: Mauritania Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Visa information and reciprocal visa-waiver list
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and Mauritanians Abroad
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Mauritanian MFA page expressly labels this as the list of countries with which Mauritania has reciprocal visa-suppression agreements and separately narrows some agreements to diplomatic/service passports. Libya, Tunisia, Mali, Niger, Côte d'Ivoire, Guinea-Bissau and Chad are named without that limitation.

sources.title: Cuba Travel: Regulations for travelling to Cuba
sources.officialityEvidence: Cuba's official tourism portal gives tourist-entry rules, identifies the visa-exempt Chinese-citizen exception and directs other visitors to the eVisaCuba electronic tourist-visa process.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The tourist visa is mandatory to enter Cuba if you do not have Cuban residency.

policies.title: Mauritanian ordinary passports: named reciprocal visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Mauritania's current MFA records reciprocal visa-waiver agreements, without a diplomatic/service-only limitation, for Libya, Tunisia, Mali, Niger, Côte d'Ivoire, Guinea-Bissau and Chad.
conditions: Use a valid Mauritanian ordinary passport. The MFA page expressly limits several other agreements to diplomatic and service passports but does not apply that limitation to these seven named destinations.

The MFA list establishes the visa-waiver route only; it does not establish duration, work, residence, transit, entry point, carrier requirements, document-recognition, mission availability or final admission conditions.
This conclusion rests on Mauritania's named reciprocal agreements, not on ECOWAS membership or a regional free-movement presumption.

policies.title: Mauritanian ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Mauritanian visitor and makes the electronic tourist-visa route available from anywhere except the United States.
conditions: Use a valid Mauritanian ordinary passport. Cuba names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; a Mauritanian ordinary-passport holder without Cuban residency must obtain the tourist visa.
Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel; Cuba's D'Viajeros declaration is separate. The tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, with a possible 90-day extension.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Mauritanian ordinary passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.
